column1: # g988-me-min.tsv: the managed entity classes the daemon serves, a row per class and a
# row per attribute, as ITU-T G.988 (11/2022) defines them. tools/gen_me_table.py makes
# Class rows come first: #class, class_id, class_name, created_by, actions, alarms, avc, instance_id, source.
#   class_id and class_name: Table 11.2.4-1 of the Recommendation; created_by: ONU or OLT, as the
#   clause says (the managed entity ID attribute is set by create when the OLT creates); actions:
#   the message types (Table 11.2.2-1) of the actions the daemon serves, which are among the ones
#   the Actions of the clause lists; alarms: number:name pairs separated by semicolons, or -;
#   avc: the attributes whose changes are announced, or -.
# Attribute rows: class_id, class_name, attr_no, attr_name, size, access, mandatory, table, source.
#   attr_no: the attribute's bit in a mask, 1 for the most significant; access: R, R,W, R,C or R,W,C
#   (C: set by create, given in the Create); size: in bytes, for a table attribute (table: yes) the
#   bytes of one entry; mandatory: as the clause says (a clause that makes an attribute mandatory
#   only for some equipment is read as mandatory); source: g988:CLAUSE, the clause of the Recommendation.
# The daemon serves the first attributes of a class and not the later ones of the Recommendation:
# attribute 16 of class 11 is left out.
# Attribute 7 of class 138, Retrieve profile, write-only in the Recommendation, is served as R,W.
